mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_reservation_task (reservation_id, type) VALUES (#{reservationId}, #{type}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE reservation_id = reservation_id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tb_reservation_task WHERE status = 0 AND next_retry_time <= NOW(3) ORDER BY next_retry_time, id LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_reservation_task SET attempts = attempts + 1, next_retry_time = DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL 30 SECOND) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0 AND next_retry_time <= NOW(3)
